entries.source: StA Zürich, C II 12,20., Nr. 1625, S. 456-457
entries.german:
Abt Berchtold und der Konvent von St. Gallen übertragen dem Kloster Rüti von Lehensträgern aufgegebenen Besitz in Oberdürnten.

Nos Bertholdus dei gratia abbas sancti Galli 1, M. deccanus 2 totusque conventus monasterii sancti Galli universis presentium || inspectoribus salutem in salutis auctore. Temporale sepe perit negotium, si non illud affirmat assertio litterarum. || Noverint igitur tam presentes quam posteri, quod venerabiles in Christo H. divina pacientia abbas totusque conventus || monasterii in Rvti 3 ordinis Premonstratensis Constan(tiensis) diocesis mansum unum situm in Obirntunretun 4 pro Rv odolfo dicto Huphan cive quodam in Raprechtswiler 5 pro XVI. marcis argenti compararunt, quem mansum idem R. nomine feodi a Wilhelmo et fratribus suis filiis domini V ol. bone memorie dicti ab Egge 6 possedit. Iidem vero filii mansum ipsum a dilectis ministerialibus nostris domino H. de Iberc 7 et domino Johan. de Lutirberc 8 et fratribus eiusdem similiter titulo feodi tenuerunt, qui ministeriales videlicet de Iberc et de Lutirberc prefatum mansum, quem et ipsi a nobis et nostro monasterio feodaliter possidebant, in manus nostras resignarunt. Nos vero ob honorem dei et gloriose virginis Marie genitricis eius necnon omnium sanctorum de consensu unanimi et voluntate concordi prefati M. prioris 9 totiusque capituli nostri monasterio predicto in Ruti et personis ibidem domino militantibus memoratum mansum libere in perpetuum concessimus perfruendum. Et ne in nobis ipsis deficiamus, unde aliis proficimus, statuimus, ut dictum monasterium in Ruti singulis annis in festo beati Galli mediam libram cere census nomine nobis et nostro monasterio ad aram sancti Galli offerendo persolvat. Ut hec autem rata et inconvulsa permaneant, presentem paginam desuper scriptam nostro nostrique capituli sigillis fecimus roborari. Testes autem sunt hii: dominus Rv odolfus de Gvttingin 10, dominus Heinricus de Rauinspurc 11, dominus Egilolfus de Rosinberc 12, dominus Rv odolfus de Rorschach 13, villicus de Windegge 14 milites, B. de Rinegge 15 notarius noster, frater Burchardus et frater Waltherus dictus Houemeistir 16 de Rvti. Datum et actum apud sanctum Gallum, anno domini M°CC°LX. tercia feria post Benedicti.

Siegel: 2 Siegel an Schnüren, besch., rest, 1. Abb. 25; 2. Abb. 21.
entries.english: Abbot Berchtold, the dean, and the whole convent of the monastery of St. Gall greet all who see this letter. Since temporal business often perishes unless confirmed in writing, let present and future generations know that the venerable abbot and convent of Rüti, of the Premonstratensian Order in the diocese of Constance, purchased a holding at Oberdürnten from Rudolf called Huphan, a citizen of Räpprechtswil, for 16 marks of silver. Rudolf held it as a fief from Wilhelm and his brothers, sons of the late lord Vol. called von Egge. They in turn held it as a fief from the monastery’s ministerials, H. von Iberc and Johann von Lutirberc and his brothers. Those ministerials held the property as a fief from St. Gall and surrendered it into the monastery’s hands. With the unanimous consent of the prior and chapter, the abbot and convent granted the holding freely and perpetually to Rüti and the religious serving God there. In return, Rüti is to pay the monastery of St. Gall half a pound of wax each year on St. Gall’s feast day, offering it at his altar. They had this charter confirmed with their seals. Among the witnesses were the knights Rudolf von Güt(t)ingen, Heinrich von Ravensburg, Egilolf von Rosenberg, Rudolf von Rorschach, and the steward of Windegg; B. von Rinegg, their notary; and the brothers Burchard and Walther called Houemeistir of Rüti. Given and enacted at St. Gall on the Tuesday after Benedict’s feast, in the year of the Lord 1260. Two damaged seals on cords.
